title: AccountWithdrawResult (v1)
description: Response of POST /api/v1/agents/{motebitId}/withdraw — the withdrawal lifecycle record in decimal USD. Non-terminal status is the fail-safe; finality is observed via status + payout_reference. See spec/market-v1.md §2.9.

destination.description: Payout address, external ref, or "pending" for manual resolution.

status.description: Withdrawal lifecycle state (pending | processing | completed | failed | cancelled). Readers MUST tolerate unknown values — the vocabulary evolves additively.

payout_reference.description: External payout id (tx hash, transfer id); null until settled.

completed_at.description: Epoch milliseconds of settlement; null while unsettled.

failure_reason.description: Populated when status is failed; MAY carry an unresolved-payout note while status is pending; otherwise null.

relay_id.description: The signing relay's MotebitId — a signed WithdrawalReceiptPayload field, present so the record is self-verifiable from the response alone.

relay_signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the completed withdrawal for offline verify; null until settled.

relay_public_key.description: Hex relay public key for independent verification; null until settled.

idempotent.description: Present and true when the idempotency key matched a prior request.
